val s = _uiState.value
        val effectiveDate = s.draftEffectiveDate.trim()
        val note = s.draftOperatorNote.trim()
        val today = s.todayDate

        if (effectiveDate.isBlank() || (today.isNotBlank() && effectiveDate <= today)) {
            isActionInProgress.set(false)
            _uiState.update { it.copy(error = localizer.get(R.string.admin_policy_date_required)) }
            return
        }

        if (note.isBlank() || note.length > 1000) {
            isActionInProgress.set(false)
            _uiState.update { it.copy(error = localizer.get(R.string.admin_policy_note_required)) }
            return
        }

        val welcome = s.draftWelcomeCredits.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
        val t1 = s.draftPenaltyTier1.toIntOrNull() ?: -1

val validBase = AppUpdateReleaseUiState(
            ownerProfile = Profile(id = "owner", credits = 200),
            currentRelease = oldRelease,
            versionName = "2.0.0",
            releaseNotes = "Fix bugs and enhance UI",
        )

        // VersionCode bằng bản cũ (25) -> Không được phép
        val stateEqual = validBase.copy(versionCode = "25")
        assertFalse(stateEqual.canPublish)

        // VersionCode nhỏ hơn bản cũ (24) -> Không được phép
        val stateLower = validBase.copy(versionCode = "24")
        assertFalse(stateLower.canPublish)

        // VersionCode lớn hơn bản cũ (26) -> Được phép
        val stateGreater = validBase.copy(versionCode = "26")
        assertTrue(stateGreater.canPublish)
    }

    @Test
    fun owner_can_publish_validates_blank_fields_and_lengths() {
        val state = AppUpdateReleaseUiState(
            ownerProfile = Profile(id = "owner", credits = 200),
            currentRelease = null,
            versionName = "",
            versionCode = "10",
            releaseNotes = "Notes",
        )
        assertFalse("versionName rỗng không được publish", state.canPublish)

        val stateNoNotes = state.copy(versionName = "1.0", releaseNotes = "   ")
        assertFalse("releaseNotes rỗng không được publish", stateNoNotes.canPublish)

        val stateTooLongName = state.copy(versionName = "A".repeat(101), releaseNotes = "Notes")

@Test
    fun getBusinessPolicyConfig_invokesCorrectRpcAndDecodesPayload() = runTest {
        var requestedRpc = ""
        val client = createClient { request ->
            requestedRpc = request.url.encodedPath
            reply(sampleConfigJson)
        }
        val repository = BusinessPolicyRepository(client)

        val config = repository.getBusinessPolicyConfig(futureLimit = 20)

        assertTrue(requestedRpc.endsWith("/rpc/admin_get_business_policy_config"))
        assertEquals("2026-11-01", config.today)
        assertEquals("rev-cas-hash-12345", config.revision)
        assertNotNull(config.activePolicy)
        assertEquals(100, config.activePolicy!!.welcomeCredits)
        assertEquals(100, config.activePolicy!!.pushFee)
        assertEquals(50, config.activePolicy!!.slotFees.slot2)
        assertEquals(30, config.activePolicy!!.slotFees.renewalDays)
        assertEquals(120, config.activePolicy!!.derivedUpdateBudget)

        assertEquals(1, config.futurePolicies.size)
        val future = config.futurePolicies[0]
        assertEquals("2026-12-01", future.effectiveFrom)
        assertEquals(150, future.welcomeCredits)
        assertEquals(120, future.pushFee)
        assertEquals(60, future.slotFees.slot2)
        assertEquals(45, future.slotFees.renewalDays)
        assertEquals(8 * 25, future.derivedUpdateBudget)
    }

@Test
    fun schedulePolicy_editingInputs_rotatesDraftRequestId() = runTest {
        val repo = FakeBusinessPolicyRepository()
        val viewModel = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, authRepository, localizer)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        viewModel.updateDraftEffectiveDate("2026-12-05")
        viewModel.updateDraftOperatorNote("Initial note")
        val reqId1 = viewModel.uiState.value.draftMutationRequestId

        // Attempt schedule (binds reqId1 to submitted hash)
        repo.shouldThrowConflict = true
        viewModel.schedulePolicy()
        advanceUntilIdle()

        // User edits note after attempt -> different intent -> new UUID
        viewModel.updateDraftOperatorNote("Updated note with new requirements")
        val reqId2 = viewModel.uiState.value.draftMutationRequestId
        assertNotEquals(reqId1, reqId2)
    }
